categories.main_business_segments: Qingdao NovelBeam Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, manufacturing, sales, and services of medical endoscopic instruments and optical products. The company focuses on medical optical imaging devices, including 4K fluorescence/white light laparoscopes, endoscope light source modules, camera adapters/lenses, and related surgical instruments. It also develops optical components for medical, industrial laser, and biometric applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages four core technology platforms: optical technology, precision mechanical technology, electronic technology, and digital image technology. It has advanced capabilities in optical system design, optical processing, coating, integration, precision mechanical design and packaging, electronic control, and digital image processing. Manufacturing follows ISO 13485 for medical devices and ISO 9001 for optical products, with key processes including laser welding, ultrasonic cleaning, and high-precision optical assembly.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include international medical device companies such as Stryker and domestic medical institutions. The company serves clinical departments like general surgery, orthopedics, gynecology, urology, and ENT. Major markets are the United States, China, and other Asian countries, with products used in minimally invasive surgeries and medical diagnostics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, the United States, and Thailand, with subsidiaries and production facilities in these regions. Overseas sales constitute a significant portion of revenue, especially in the US market, while domestic sales are growing rapidly. The company also exports to Europe and South America.
categories.supply_chain_position: Qingdao NovelBeam Technology operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and assembly of medical endoscopic systems and optical components. It integrates core components and produces finished medical devices, supplying both OEM/ODM products and its own branded systems.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in medical endoscopy and optical imaging, emphasizing 4K, fluorescence, 3D imaging, and AI-assisted diagnostic technologies. It follows a 'transformation, development, and reserve' R&D model, collaborating with clinical institutions and research centers. Future R&D focuses include miniaturized endoscopes, integrated surgical imaging solutions, AI image recognition, and expanding product lines to cover surgical microscopes and related instruments.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of medical endoscopic instruments, optical components, and related surgical devices. The company operates via ODM, OEM, and direct sales of its own branded products. It also earns income from maintenance services, technical services, and leasing of certain assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic innovator in medical endoscopy and optical imaging, competing with international giants like Stryker. It has established long-term partnerships with top global medical device manufacturers and is expanding its presence in the domestic market through brand development and product localization. The company benefits from China's policy support for domestic substitution of imported medical devices.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 442.83 million, a slight decline of 5.9% from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 135.35 million, down 7.11%. Total assets grew by 4.68% to RMB 1.46 billion. The company maintains strong R&D investment at over 12% of revenue and has a stable cash flow with prudent financial management.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Qingdao NovelBeam Technology emphasizes its vertically integrated capabilities from core optical components to complete endoscopic systems, enabling rapid innovation and high-quality production. Its products feature advanced optical designs such as non-spherical lenses, 4K ultra-high-definition imaging, fluorescence imaging, and AI-enhanced diagnostics. The company offers comprehensive clinical solutions tailored to key surgical specialties, supporting minimally invasive procedures with superior imaging quality and reliability.
